body: The South Australian Skills Commission has announced a major change for international students planning to study trade courses in South Australia. Previously, schools that could teach trade courses had a rule: certain trade courses needed an approved apprenticeship agreement.

This no longer applies to schools offering trade courses, for both existing and new enrolments. If you're planning on studying a trade course in South Australia, talk to our Registered Migration Agent Tushar Chopra (MARN 2418420) at PFEC Global.
